rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's statement titled 橋本内閣総理大臣談話 and dated 11 January 1996 opens with the Prime Minister saying that he has that day taken on the heavy responsibility of Prime Minister (私は、本日、内閣総理大臣の重責を担うことになりました); it names the cabinet the 'reform and creation cabinet'.

rows.text: The same page, whose title is 橋本内閣総理大臣談話, also carries the 内閣総理大臣説示 dated 11 January 1996 (平成八年一月十一日), which opens 'On the occasion of the first cabinet meeting' (初閣議に際し) with the Prime Minister's instructions to the ministers of the new cabinet.
